title: fix(app-shell): a read-only package's Studio landing card points at org overlay and the marketplace (objectui#11808)
body:
Fixes #11808

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The Studio landing (`BuilderLanding`) said two different things about *Duplicate*, and its read-only package card had no route forward. Both now follow ADR-0070 as triage read it (comment 6043283623): D4's *Duplicate* clones a writable base, and a code or installed package is customized by org overlay where `allowOrgOverride` allows it (D2, ADR-0005).

- **Comments (H3).** The comment above the duplicate state no longer says a read-only code package is "a STARTING POINT" that "duplicate re-namespaces … into a new writable base", nor that Duplicate is "the real substance behind Home's Start with a template". It states D4's reading: Duplicate clones a writable base and is offered on writable bases only; a read-only package is customized by org overlay; Home's template card opens the marketplace. The comment beside the Duplicate button says the same. The module doc's "the ADR-0070 D4 gate" for writability now reads D2, the server's `PkgEntry.writable` verdict.
- **Read-only card.** Each card keeps its browse click (`/studio/PACKAGE_ID/data`) and gains *Customize with an overlay*, a link to `/apps/setup/metadata?package=PACKAGE_ID`: the package's metadata directory, which marks per type whether it accepts an org overlay.
- **Read-only section.** One sentence under the heading says why: these packages are not edited or duplicated here, and are customized with an org overlay for the metadata types that accept one. Below it, *Or install a template app from the marketplace* links `/apps/setup/system/marketplace`, rendered only when `isMarketplaceEnabled()` holds.
- **Copy.** Four new `engine.studio.landing.*` rows in en and zh, and the reworded `engine.studio.landing.description`, which called code-loaded packages "browse only".

Left as they are: *Duplicate* stays writable-only (option A, duplicating a read-only package into a writable copy, would amend ADR-0070 D4 and only the maintainer can ask for it); the Duplicate form and `isSpecPackageId`; `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`; `packages/components/src/ui/**`; `packages/i18n/**`. No export, prop, route or language-pack key is added.

Files: `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.readonlyRoutes-11808.test.tsx` (new), `.changeset/11808-readonly-package-card.md` (new, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch), and `content/docs/guide/console.md` (one row, in `a8d4e93`). All inside claim 6054313545's file surface, as amended by the seat for the docs row.

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured on 340bfab

**H1, the routes exist: partly falsified. The card follows the measurement.**
- *Org overlay of a read-only package's object:* no such route. `allowOrgOverride` is a flag on the metadata TYPE, never on a package or an object (ADR-0005, "Tenant-customizable type whitelist"; spec `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`). On objectstack `origin/main` (`51290bca`) it is true for `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `translation` and `email_template`, and false for `object`, so no object can be overlaid. The console's overlay editor is `ResourceEditPage` at `/apps/setup/metadata/TYPE/NAME`, which lets an artifact item be edited only when its type has `allowOrgOverride`. The package-scoped way in is the directory, `/apps/setup/metadata?package=PACKAGE_ID` (`MetadataDirectoryPage`, the `metadata` index route in both branches of `AppContent`). It honours `?package=` against `buildPackageScopeOptions`, which drops only `system` / `cloud` scope. `parsePackages` hides the same two scopes, so every package on the landing's read-only list is a valid scope there.
- *Marketplace:* `/apps/setup/system/marketplace`, declared in both `AppContent` branches. A runtime with `features.marketplace: false` mounts no marketplace (objectui#5504), so the link is withheld there.
- *Template start:* Home's *Start with a template* navigates to the same `/apps/setup/system/marketplace` (gated on `canAuthorMetadata` and `isMarketplaceEnabled()`). "Marketplace or template" is therefore one route.
- What this means for the clause "where `allowOrgOverride` is false for the package or object, the card does not offer the overlay": the flag has no per-package answer. The card links to the page that shows the per-type answer, and the section's sentence says why only some types can be customized.
- NOT MEASURED in a browser. Reason: no backend in this container (the objectstack checkout has no `node_modules`). Measured by route declarations plus the new test under a real `MemoryRouter`.

**H2, the facts are on the card's data: falsified for overlay.** `PkgEntry` carries `writable` (the server's verdict) and no overlay fact. Whether a package ships any overlayable type needs two reads the console makes only on the directory page: `useMetadataTypes`, and `useGlobalDiagnostics`'s `packagesByType`, one call per package. Neither was added, and no endpoint was added.

**H3, the comments: holds.** Every comment in `BuilderLanding.tsx` that speaks of Duplicate and read-only packages states D4's reading. `grep -ci 'STARTING POINT\|re-namespaces\|writable copy'` on the file answers 0.

## Tests and gates

New: `BuilderLanding.readonlyRoutes-11808.test.tsx`, 6 cases, read off the real `BuilderLanding` under a real router. The marketplace flag is booted through the real `initRuntimeConfig()` over a stubbed `GET /api/v1/runtime/config`.

Reverse verification, run after the fix was committed: the base commit's `BuilderLanding.tsx` (340bfab) was written back to disk (`overlayPath` count 0, `STARTING POINT` count 1), and the new file ran `Tests 3 failed | 3 passed (6)`. The three red cases are the overlay link and both marketplace cases. The three green ones pin behaviour the base already had: the browse click, Duplicate on writable bases only, and no read-only section when there is no read-only package. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, proven by a blob hash equal to HEAD's and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

At `1049ee0fb` (code). The docs round `a8d4e93` changes one docs line. Its own gates passed on `a8d4e93`: `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check:doc-types`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, and the 17 `content/docs` sweep suites (806 tests).
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the three BuilderLanding tests, `studio-locale.i18n.test.tsx`, `column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` and the eight console tests that name `BuilderLanding`: `Test Files 13 passed (13)`, `Tests 67 passed (67)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFilesOnly` on the test config lists the new test): exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` (`Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`).
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the three touched source files, `--format json`: 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The population is the files this diff touches; CI's `lint` runs each package's `eslint .`, and `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Exit 0 with their own verdict lines: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity` ("Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."), `check:i18n-drift` ("Every changed designer-table en value was followed by its zh row."), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only; none of this diff's keys listed), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Docs-driven rule (AGENTS.md #2).** No existing doc sentence becomes false: the app-shell README's "a read-only package opens in Studio as browse-only" still holds, because the card still opens browse-only. `content/docs/guide/console.md` now has a *Read-only Packages in Studio* row in its Key Features table (`a8d4e93`), under the seat's amendment of the claim surface.
- **No per-package overlay verdict on the card.** A package that ships only non-overlayable types (objects and flows only, say) still shows the overlay link, and its directory then shows every type locked. Hiding the link for such a package needs the per-package read described under H2.
- **The marketplace link is gated on the runtime flag only.** It is not gated on `canAuthorMetadata` the way Home's template card is: Studio is entered only with `studio.access`, a platform-admin-only capability, and nothing else on this page is gated on it either.
